references.text: King Amaziah followed this principle by not putting to death the children of those who had killed his father, in accordance with what is written in the Law of Moses.

Amaziah did not put the murderers' children to death, but acted according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses: Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor children for their fathers.
Ezekiel confirms the principle of individual responsibility: The one who sins shall die. A son shall not bear his father's guilt.
The prophet repeats that the one who sins shall die personally. A son shall not suffer for his father's sin, and a father shall not suffer for his son's sin.
Jeremiah speaks of the new covenant in which each person will die for their own sin, not for their fathers' wrongdoing.
